outcomeDiff: No difference from the planned outcome. Beyond plan: a genuine 2-host REVIEW (4 claude lanes + codex host-2) ran 4 rounds and resolved 17 findings; codex host-2 progressively caught 6 deeper soundness holes in the anti-gaming selfcheck (harness tamper -> source-dir tamper -> env preload -> PATH spoof -> TOCTOU -> harness-aware solution) that the 4 same-vendor lanes passed each round; F-007/008/009/010 were fixed (tamper-proofed), and the last three vectors (F-011/012/013, dup F-015/016/017) are accepted out-of-threat-model per operator decision and documented in a threat-model block.
limitations: corpus-selfcheck is sound against ACCIDENTAL invariant violations + stratification drift in our SELF-AUTHORED corpus (its purpose, fulfilled). It is NOT a sandbox against a MALICIOUS in-process task author: PATH spoof (F-011/F-015), post-hash TOCTOU (F-012/F-016), and a harness-aware solution reading process.argv[1] (F-013/F-017) can bypass the in-process invariant; F-013 is fundamentally unblockable in-process. These are accepted_risk (operator decision) and documented in the corpus-selfcheck.mjs threat-model block + README; closing them needs real execution isolation (a locked-down subprocess + indistinguishable harnesses) = a separate optional follow-up. Irrelevant to this corpus, whose 20 payloads are genuine self-authored subtle bugs (concept lane + codex spot-checks confirmed).
pitfalls: The 20-task corpus was produced by a parallel design+verify workflow then INDEPENDENTLY re-validated by the main agent (20/20 pass) before the story.
